decisions.reason: The enclosed laser marking workstation was launched only in 2023 and its prospects are still uncertain, while keeping it costs little because it builds on the firm's in-house laser technology and suits its approach of matching technologies to each application, so the option stays open.

The high-resolution thermal inkjet printer has its own product page and brings recurring consumables revenue in a growing market, so the early evidence supports further commitment rather than abandonment.

The high-resolution piezo inkjet printer is prominently presented and covers surfaces and applications that thermal inkjet cannot, so it adds to the single-source portfolio at low holding cost and is worth keeping while its value resolves.
